findings.claim: The supplied regional evidence is a label-bound favorable-minus-comparison enrichment contrast (measure 'enrichment_z'), not an absolute geometric descriptor; effect_z is the contrast divided by the original feature scale, so signs are not comparable across observables as a shared quality axis.

At region 0, landmark_00 local_cyy shows a positive signed contrast (effect_z ~0.575, q~1.3e-4, positive_batch_fraction 1.0) and local_cxx is also positive (effect_z ~0.579, q~1.8e-3), while landmark_00 soft_mass is negative (effect_z ~-0.639, q~1.9e-4, positive_batch_fraction 0.0).

At region 1, landmark_01 local_cyy is positive (effect_z ~0.560, q~1.3e-4, positive_batch_fraction 1.0) and local_dy is positive (effect_z ~0.499, q~4.2e-3), whereas landmark_01 local_cxz is negative (effect_z ~-0.381, q~0.061).

At region 2, landmark_02 local_dy is negative (effect_z ~-0.405, q~1.3e-4, positive_batch_fraction 0.0) and local_dz is negative (effect_z ~-0.262, q~0.029), while landmark_02 soft_mass is weakly positive (effect_z ~0.151, q~0.089).

The observed support is the native model endpoint world coordinates over score times 0.0-0.49 with learning window 0.0-0.5 and curve support 0.0-0.49; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so these contrasts are selection enrichment, not absolute affinity.

hypotheses.falsifier: A region/component with a stable sign across independent batches and a confidence interval excluding zero in the opposite direction.
hypotheses.scope: observed selection nodes, regions 0-2, observed window 0.0-0.49
hypotheses.statement: Signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes are non-uniform across regions and components, with local_cyy consistently positive at regions 0 and 1 and local_dy sign-flipping between regions 1 and 2.

limitations: Only regional contrast evidence is supplied in this isolated interface probe; no outcome evaluation data are available to this role.
Effect_z signs are not comparable across observables as a shared quality axis without each observable's definition.
These are selection-enrichment contrasts at observed nodes, not absolute geometric descriptors, physical interaction energies, or evidence of neural-module causation.
No temporal-derivative or trajectory-velocity interpretation is supported by the supplied evidence.
